due.definition:
n. that which is deserved or owed
n. a payment that is due (e.g., as the price of membership)
a. owed and payable immediately or on demand
s. scheduled to arrive
due.translation:
n. 应得的东西, 应付款
a. 到期的, 应得的, 应付的, 约定的

due care.translation: 行为准则; 应有的注意

due date.translation:
[计] 预定日期
[化] 期满日期

due diligence.translation: 应有的注意; 尽职调查

due east.translation:
n. 正东，
adj. 向正东

due from correspondent.translation: [经] 应收代理商店(客户往来)欠款

due north.translation:
n. 正北方
adj. 向正北方

due process.translation: [法] 正当手续, 法定诉讼程序

due professional care.translation: [经] 必须有专家(内行)的照管

due regard.translation: [法] 应有注意, 应有尊重

due south.translation:
n. 正南方
adj. 向正南方

duebill.definition:
n. A brief written acknowledgment of a debt, not made payable
   to order, like a promissory note.

duel.definition:
n. a prearranged fight with deadly weapons by two people (accompanied by seconds) in order to settle a quarrel over a point of honor
n. any struggle between two skillful opponents (individuals or groups)
v. fight a duel, as over one's honor or a woman
duel.translation:
n. 决斗, 斗争
vi. 决斗

dueled.translation: 使（另一人）参加决斗（duel的过去式与过去分词形式）

dueler.definition: n. One who engages in a duel.

dueling.definition: v fight a duel, as over one's honor or a woman

duelist.definition: n a person who fights duels

duelled.definition: v. fight a duel, as over one's honor or a woman
duelled.translation:
n. 决斗；(两人或两党之间的)竞争, 抗争, 争斗, 斗争, 冲突
vi. 决斗：；斗争, 争斗, 冲突：
vt. 与…决斗：；[废语]在决斗中杀死(或战胜)

dueller.translation:
n. 〈罕〉同“duelist”
[网络] 普利司通动力侠；杜勒；决斗者

duelling.definition: v fight a duel, as over one's honor or a woman

duellist.definition: n a person who fights duels

duellists.definition:
plural of duellist
n a person who fights duels
duellists.translation: (duellist 的复数) n. 决斗者

duels.definition:
n a prearranged fight with deadly weapons by two people (accompanied by seconds) in order to settle a quarrel over a point of honor
n any struggle between two skillful opponents (individuals or groups)
v fight a duel, as over one's honor or a woman
duels.translation: n. 两男子的决斗( duel的名词复数 ); 竞争, 斗争

dueness.definition: n. Quality of being due; debt; what is due or becoming.

duennaship.translation: n. 少女的保姆 (duenna的变形)

duerden.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 杜尔登 Dearden的变体

duergar.translation: [网络] 灰矮人；杜加矮人；杜尔加

dues.definition:
n that which is deserved or owed
n a payment that is due (e.g., as the price of membership)
dues.translation:
n. 税, 应付款, 该缴之款
[经] 会费, 捐费, 手续费

duet.definition:
n. two performers or singers who perform together
n. a musical composition for two performers

duets.definition:
n. two items of the same kind
n. two performers or singers who perform together
n. a pair who associate with one another
duets.translation: n. 二重奏曲, 二重唱曲( duet的复数形式 ); 二重唱者

duetted.definition:
past tense of duet
n. two performers or singers who perform together
n. a musical composition for two performers
duetted.translation: (duet 的过去时) n. 二重奏

duetting.definition:
-ing form of duet
n. two performers or singers who perform together
n. a musical composition for two performers
duetting.translation: (duet 的现在分词) n. 二重奏

duettists.translation: (duettist 的复数) n. 二重奏者
